title: Mara and the Sigil
premise: Theo Eastwick, an exiled storm-caller keeping ledgers for a guild that trades in impossible things, is pressed by a dying stranger named Mara with a map to the court beneath the mountain. Mara's soul was sold there as collateral for a debt she never owed, and the guild itself brokered the sale. As Theo and Mara descend, they discover the guild's master intends to feed Mara's soul to the court to buy his own pardon from an old crime. In the end Theo must choose between loyalty to the guild that once sheltered them and the truth of what it has done, tearing up their own ledger to void the debt and freeing Mara at the cost of exile made permanent.
about_author: Lior Nystrom is a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing merchant guild records in coastal trading towns before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about paper trails, debts, and the people who keep both.

chapters.title: The Ledger Room
chapters.summary: POV Theo. In the guild's candlelit counting house, Theo balances accounts of traded years, borrowed shadows, and bottled luck, hiding their storm-calling brand beneath long sleeves. A bleeding woman staggers in during a storm and collapses against the desk. Emotional beat: quiet dread as routine cracks open.

chapters.title: A Map in Unwilling Hands
chapters.summary: POV Theo. The stranger, Mara, presses a bloodstained map into Theo's hands and names the court beneath the mountain before losing consciousness. Guild enforcers arrive asking questions Theo cannot safely answer. Emotional beat: panic and the first pull toward a choice Theo hasn't agreed to make.

chapters.title: What the Guild Owes
chapters.summary: POV Theo. Searching the ledgers, Theo finds Mara's soul recorded as sold collateral on a debt signed in her name by someone else. Master Corvane orders the map surrendered; Theo lies for the first time. Emotional beat: loyalty beginning to curdle into suspicion.

chapters.title: Mara Wakes
chapters.summary: POV Mara. Recovering in a smuggler's attic, Mara tells her story: a forged signature, a brother's betrayal, a soul auctioned while she slept. She doesn't trust Theo, but the map only works when they hold it together. Emotional beat: wary alliance forged out of necessity.

chapters.title: Down the Salt Road
chapters.summary: POV Theo. Fleeing guild hunters through salt flats and dead villages, Theo uses forbidden storm-calling to survive an ambush, revealing their exile's cause. Mara sees the scars the guild helped hide. Emotional beat: intimacy born of shared damage.

chapters.title: The Tollgate of Small Mercies
chapters.summary: POV Mara. At the mountain's threshold, a ferryman demands payment in memories. Mara trades away her wedding day; Theo secretly pays part of her toll with their own. Emotional beat: sacrifice offered without witness, trust deepening.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath
chapters.summary: POV Theo. Descending into the subterranean court, they find souls kept as ledger entries in a vault of glass drawers. Theo recognizes the guild's seal on dozens of sales, including one bearing Corvane's own name. Emotional beat: horror at the scale of the trade.

chapters.title: Corvane's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Mara. Corvane arrives to complete his purchase: Mara's soul in exchange for erasure of his old crime. He offers Theo reinstatement and their name cleared if they hand her over. Emotional beat: the loyalty-versus-truth choice laid bare at its cruelest price.

chapters.title: The Torn Page
chapters.summary: POV Theo. Climax. Theo invokes the guild's oldest law: any debt may be voided by destroying its record in the debtor's presence. They fight through the vault, tear the page holding Mara's entry, and call a storm underground to scatter the court's clerks. Emotional beat: fury transmuted into justice outside the law.

chapters.title: Exile, Twice Over
chapters.summary: POV Mara. Above ground, Mara whole again, the two face a guild that will never take them back and a world that never wanted them. They burn the map, keep each other, and walk toward a town where no one knows their names. Emotional beat: bittersweet freedom chosen together.
